svg.desc: An RPG-style skill tree. Root: Python, level intermediate. Unlocked branches: FastAPI (shipped it), Ollama with Gemma (runs on my laptop), JavaScript (Discord-bot era), React with Vite (built a UI). Locked nodes still being learned: Django, and SQL at basics. Side panel: tools equipped are Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel and the Gemini API; quest in progress: data structures and algorithms.
